_what_this_is: Per-case, per-sample refusal detail for this arm, taken from the audit records fetched back out of the lake rather than from the gateway's response. The answer files carry what was answered; this carries WHY the rest was not, which `evals/run_evals.py` cannot express - it scores a refused case as a plain FAIL, indistinguishable from one that answered badly. `channel` says whether a guardrail block was a refusal of the viewer's question or of content the platform was about to put in the model's context (ADR-035).
